responsibility: Defines the core `Parser` state and shared parsing infrastructure for the module, including token navigation, recovery mode, capture bookkeeping, helper macros, delimiter error construction, and cross-cutting utilities used by all parser submodules.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `lexer/mod.rs`, this module starts from token streams and defines the shared `Parser` machinery for navigating, recovering, and assembling AST syntax according to Rust grammar, rather than performing raw source-text tokenization.
